raspberrypi/rpi-eeprom issue #776: after the 2025-11-05 Pi 5 EEPROM, USB mass-storage boot fails ('Fatal firmware error', code 45) when a second USB storage device is attached; workaround PARTITION_WALK=0; a Raspberry Pi collaborator reports 'Fix merged' and closes it 2025-12-18 (an EEPROM regression that affects any OS on the Pi 5)
